scope: Supplemental fit conditional on frozen provisional parameters; not independent of archived fit because Kstar and phi PDG width inputs overlap. Do not add chi2 values.
covariance_assumption: Quoted summary covariance; phi BR correlation -0.72 retained, other cross-correlations unavailable and set to zero; no fixed-parameter uncertainty propagated.
excluded_rho: rho to pi pi total width saturates its total-width input already present in the provisional fit; no independent additional row.
